scope: whole-board grading, selective mechanical recovery, and sale comparison

workflow.title: Scan before touching
workflow.instruction: Run Board Sense on the intact board and save the grade, board family, confidence, and reference matches.

workflow.title: Check whole-board category
workflow.instruction: Determine whether the board belongs in a specialty buyer category before removing valuable components.

workflow.title: Mark high-interest components
workflow.instruction: Use Spike Glass to inspect processors, RAM, gold fingers, relays/contacts, transformers, heat sinks, connectors, and unusual IC packages.

workflow.title: Route to labs
workflow.instruction: Send identified components to their Recovery Lab categories and keep uncertain items intact for review.

workflow.title: Selective depopulation
workflow.instruction: Remove components only when their separated value or recovery value is expected to exceed the lost whole-board value plus labor.

workflow.title: Keep fractions clean
workflow.instruction: Separate copper-rich, aluminum, steel, precious-metal-bearing, and remaining PCB fractions instead of remixing them.

workflow.title: Run economics
workflow.instruction: Use Worth My Time? with actual labor minutes and buyer/refinery quotes to decide whether the workflow should be repeated on similar boards.

decision_rule: The default is not to depopulate everything. Preserve whole-board value unless selective recovery has a measurable advantage.
